data_output.description: data.py load/encode must return encoded[split] as (features, labels, users), where features is an int32 matrix with columns ordered user_id, video_id, tab, hourmin, weekday; labels is the long_view float32 vector; users is the original validation user_id vector. Feature vocabularies and offsets are fitted only on train rows, unseen values map to per-field unknown buckets, and split row order is preserved exactly.

model_input.description: model.py remains unchanged and receives the expanded additive feature matrix plus its total encoded dimension. It must sum the learned weights for every feature column, apply the existing sigmoid/logit behavior, and train with the existing pointwise BCE step; no interactions, architecture changes, or baseline-derived features are permitted.
